verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency.css','utf8');const m=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/members-shell.css','utf8');const u=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/members-ui.css','utf8');const bad=[];const dayOnly=(t)=>{const i=f.indexOf(t);if(i<0)return false;const o=f.lastIndexOf('{',i);return f.slice(f.lastIndexOf('}',o)+1,o).includes(':not(.dark)')};if(!dayOnly('--fq-bg-canvas: #F4F6F7'))bad.push('the cooled day canvas still overrides the night canvas, so the Menu sheet stays light in dark mode');if(!dayOnly('--fq-accent-soft: #E4F3F4'))bad.push('the pale day accent-soft still paints accent tags and calendar chips at night');if(!/\.fqm-tb\.on \.fqm-tb-l\{[^}]*color:var\(--fq-text-strong\)/.test(m))bad.push('the active tab label takes the dark ink meant for its chip');if(!/\[data-tone=.ink.\]\{--fqm-tone:var\(--fq-text-strong\)/.test(m))bad.push('the Menu sheet tiles lose the ink tone, which is light at night');if(!/\.dark\[data-design=.frequency.\] \[data-kit=.members.\] \.tag\{background:var\(--fqm-white-75\)/.test(u))bad.push('the kit tag stays white glass at night');if(!/\.dark\[data-design=.frequency.\] \[data-kit=.members.\] \.ph\{background-color:var\(--fq-bg-sunken\)/.test(u))bad.push('a photo-less card keeps the kit sand placeholder at night');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-917: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
